description.value: E-bike rentals, self-guided tours, and a scheduled shuttle serving the Galloping Goose Trail between Victoria, Metchosin and Sooke. Rentals can be picked up at the shuttle stops. The shuttle runs April to October; a one-way pass with your own bike is $19, and rental-plus-shuttle packages run $119 to $129 per person. Everything must be booked in advance. No street address is published; contact them to arrange a meeting point.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Electric Alpine Biking is an e-bike rental and shuttle-supported experience operator on the Galloping Goose Regional Trail, with pickup locations in both Sooke (Sooke River Road) and Victoria (Atkins Road). No repair services, pumps, or workshop amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; the trail FAQ explicitly states 'mechanical support for your bike is your own responsibility' for riders bringing their own bikes. Bike rentals (Volt Yukon step-through e-bikes, including multi-day and family add-ons) and one-way shuttle service are clearly confirmed across multiple pages.
concerns: OSM record has no address, phone, or osm_id — minimal OSM data; location coordinates (48.406454, -123.703983) place the pin in the Sooke area, consistent with one of two listed pickup locations but not verified against a specific street address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible e-bike rental and shuttle business with confirmed online booking; directly relevant to touring cyclists on the Galloping Goose corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business operates from two pickup locations: Sooke River Road (Sooke area) and Atkins Road (Victoria/West Shore area). The OSM pin near Sooke likely corresponds to the Sooke River Road location.

E-bike charging.detail: FAQ states: 'Charging is not available on the trail, and you should ensure that you and your bike have the ability to ride the selected trail mileage.'
